title: Better Emerald Trims
description: Makes the emerald trims look better by making the lightest colors darker, specifically aimed at diamond armor.
body:
# Beter Emerald Trims!
## By TeeVeo :3

If you've ever used emerald trims on diamond armor, you would know it looks kind of bad compared to the colors of other trims.
This rescource pack aims to fix that by making the lightest colors of the emerald trim color palette darker so it clashes more with the texture of diamond armor.

I tested this only on 1.21.10 but I'm sure it works on basically all versions.

This project holds no copyright or anything whatsoever, in fact I encourage as many people to use it as possible.
